  "analytical_usefulness": 0.6,
  "source_groundedness": 0.92,
  "rationale": "Most columns are well-grounded, mechanically derivable features that give real modeling leverage for predicting review score, with the sentiment-word counts, helpfulness_ratio, and punctuation features being the strongest. Several length-type columns are grounded but generic and mutually redundant, lowering their individual usefulness. The main groundedness concern is has_product_mention, which is near-constant and appears to mislabel rows that plainly mention products, indicating an unreliable derivation. Overall the set is largely sound on both necessary conditions."
